Alphabet is a for-profit public company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, United States. It trades under the ticker GOOGL and holds SEC CIK number 0001652044. Its website, abc.xyz, presents itself as an investor relations home page, and the material available from that site describes the company in those investor-facing terms rather than detailing its operating businesses.

The held facts list no products for Alphabet, and no MCP servers or lawsuits are recorded. Its legal exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281.

Nothing further about its AI products or market position appears in the available material.
